spec.assertion: it.skip — TriggerDef has no on-damage-taken kind and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the condition is unreachable. Recipe recorded on the skip.

Clearing skill1 entirely leaves every unit's total byte-identical — proves the line is damage-inert. Fails under the nearest-wrong scope error (39.18 encoded as atkPct/attackDamagePct), which would move totals.
buffApply stat==='maxAmmoFlat' && value===2. Fails under maxAmmoPct:2 (▲2 read as 2% ≈ 0 rounds on a 6-round magazine) or any other magnitude.

Stripping the ammo effect strictly LOWERS the summed damage of the recipients (read off the event log, not assumed). Proves the weapon-state modifier is live damage, not a cosmetic stat; fails if the ammo grant is inert or unreachable.

spec.kitLine: Affects 2 allies w/ highest final ATK
spec.assertion: Per-window target count (grouped by shared expiresFrame) is exactly 2. Fails under target {kind:'allies'} (4 targets/window in this 4-unit fixture) or alliesTopAtk count 1/3. Separately, patching count 2→3 must change totals — so the count is proven load-bearing, not incidental.

Inspection: target.kind==='alliesTopAtk', byFinalAtk===true (the literal word "final" → live effectiveAtk ranking), excludeSelf unset (no "except the skill user" clause, so mica is eligible for her own grant). Fails under static-ATK ranking or a self-exclusion the kit never states.

≥2 distinct application windows over the 180s fight. Fails under a permanent `passive` encoding (one window at frame 0, ~100% uptime instead of a duty cycle) and under passive+durationSec 10 (one window, then dead for 170s). Cadence itself is ⛑ (see gaps) and is deliberately NOT pinned.

buffApply stat==='defPct' value 19.89, with application count, window frames and per-window target sets identical to the ammo line. Fails if the line is dropped as "defensive, inert" (taxonomy 7 says keep the stat buff for a future consumer) or split onto a different target set/cadence.

Two runs: atkPct→0 must lower mica's total (the line does real damage, with the damage INSTANCE retained so burst-gauge impacts and the whole rotation stay identical — no FB-count confound); atkPct→152.22 must be a byte-identical no-op (pins the exact shipped magnitude). A guard asserts the patch matched exactly one flatDamage, so a burst with no damage effect cannot pass vacuously.

Forcing noFb:true is a no-op on mica's total. Fails if the hit currently takes the +50% Full Burst major — the trigger-identity trap of keying burst damage to fullBurstEnter instead of the owner's burstCast (a burst cast lands before the FB window opens).
Inspection: the flatDamage-carrying burst block is trigger burstCast + target enemy. Fails under fullBurstEnter/stageEnter keying or a self/ally target.

it.skip: StatKey has no enemy-DEF-reduction channel. PLUS an ACTIVE guard — no buffApply anywhere (including casterIdx===null boss-held debuffs) carries damageTakenPct with value 13.32. DEF ▼ is a SUBTRACTIVE reduction on the per-hit boss-DEF term; damageTakenPct is a multiplicative bucket, so folding one into the other over-credits the whole team by roughly an order of magnitude. This is the fudge the assertion exists to catch.

The set of stats mica ever applies, across BOTH fixtures, contains nothing outside {maxAmmoFlat, defPct}. Fails on any invented offensive buff (atkPct / attackDamagePct / critRatePct) on a Supporter whose entire buff payload is one ammo grant and two DEF grants.

fixtures: TWO comps, 8 hoisted 180s runs. (1) CTRL = controlComp('mica') -> [liter(B1), crown(B2), mica, helm(B3)], boss Fire, focus mica: bursts actually chain, and the team spans three distinct class ATK tiers (Attacker helm 118,027 / Supporter liter+mica 98,367 / Defender crown 78,707), which is what makes a top-2 target set behaviourally separable from an all-allies mis-scope. Carries every skill1/skill2 assertion. (2) B1 = [mica, crown, helm], boss Fire, focus crown: mica is the SOLE Burst I, so she casts her own burst every rotation. CTRL deliberately cannot carry the burst assertions — liter is also a 20s Burst I in slot 1 and wins the stage-1 slot under first-ready selection, so mica's burst block may never fire there and every burst assertion would be silently vacuous. Every counterfactual increments a hit-counter that is itself asserted (canonHits/zeroHits/noFbHits===1, ammoStripped>0, retargeted>0), so a patch that matched nothing fails loudly rather than passing as a no-op.
gaps: it.skip skill1 trigger — "Activates when attacked 20 time(s)": no on-damage-taken TriggerDef kind exists, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the 20-hit condition is unreachable even if the primitive existed. Missing primitive + unobservable at the validation basis.

it.skip burst DEF ▼13.32% for 5 sec — no enemy-DEF-reduction StatKey. damageTakenPct is NOT a substitute (boss DEF is subtracted per hit; damage-taken is a multiplicative bucket), so the line must live in `unmodeled` until a bossDefPct-style stat is threaded into the per-hit DEF subtraction. Note this is a real team-wide damage gain being left on the table, not a defensive no-op — worth flagging to the driver.

⛑ NOT ASSERTED — skill2's trigger CADENCE. The skill has no activation clause, so by convention it is an `interval` keyed to the datamined skill cooldown, which is outside this packet (the packet gives only burst cd 20s). The tests pin that the window REPEATS and is not permanent, but deliberately do not pin the period. Recipe: read skillCooldownsSec for mica, or count her buff windows against a focus recording.

⛑ NOT ASSERTED — byFinalAtk ranking is checked by INSPECTION only, not behaviourally. Discriminating live-ATK from static-ATK ranking needs a fixture where buffs actually reorder the top 2, which cannot be guaranteed blind (liter and mica are both Supporters at identical 98,367 base ATK, so the pair is tie-sensitive).
